method: Fetched every origin branch matching devin/wave-g/*, devin/wave-g2/*, devin/wave-h/* and extracted every committed datasets/experiments/wave-g*|wave-h/*summary*.json (35 summary files from 33 branches; g11 and g12 also carry copies of upstream f23 summaries). Classified each open item against the wave-h triage taxonomy. 'fixedOnBranch' means the fix exists ONLY on the named unmerged branch and is NOT in the RC baseline; nothing here is fixed at the RC SHA unless stated.
waveHSummariesNote: At collection time (2026-08-29 ~18:20 UTC, after a re-fetch that picked up g12/g18/h07) NO other devin/wave-h/* branches were present on origin; wave-h peers had not yet pushed summaries. This register consumes all 24 wave-g + 9 wave-g2 workstream summaries. If further wave-h branches appear after this snapshot, the register must be regenerated before GO.

p0.title: TARGET never abstains — every wrong lock is a silent high-confidence failure
p0.evidence: 54/54 locked, 17 errors, 0 abstentions; worst sessions afn-sigonella-2025 1/4 correct (3 silent), afn-sasebo-2025-06 3/7 (4 silent); contested_region 23/36 with 13 silent.
p0.status: UNRESOLVED at RC. acquire-v4 (bench: correct .863, contested wrong .167) is the measured remedy but is gated on live tap captures + one-shot locked_test (D-027 pattern) — not promotable internally.
p0.releaseImpact: Silent wrong-target drives every downstream stage confidently wrong for the wrong player. Mitigated only by the claim gate (no accuracy claims) and canary monitoring; must be an explicit accepted-risk D-number for any GO.

p0.title: Session end left ready analyses unreachable (state chips with no route to content)
p0.evidence: LiveSummaryScreen rendered READY chips with no navigation to the analysis; after end() the user had no path to results — core-flow dead end.
p0.status: FIXED on branch devin/wave-g/g21-session-e2e (ready rows navigate to Result by real analysisId; pinned failing-then-fixed test). NOT in RC baseline — requires merge.
p0.releaseImpact: Blocker if released unmerged: session flow silently loses user results.

p0.title: Stale live-window evidence stamped into a new clip's EnvelopeVerdict (evidence fabrication across attempts)
p0.evidence: AnalyzeScreen.run() did not reset lastReadiness/lastQuality; a second attempt with no live events inherited the previous attempt's measurements as its own stored verdict.
p0.status: FIXED on branch devin/wave-g/g22-tryagain-audit with regression test (analyzeScreenRearmSignals). NOT in RC baseline — requires merge.
p0.releaseImpact: Fabricated capture evidence attributed to the wrong clip is a data-integrity/truthfulness blocker.

p0.title: stroke-heuristic-6 flips confident FOREHAND↔BACKHAND under tiny perturbations (confident wrong stroke)
p0.evidence: 8/594 evaluations flipped a confident committed side to the OPPOSITE confident side under sigma=0.002-0.01u noise or 10-15fps decimation (noise-decided dominant-wrist argmax on near-tied travels).
p0.status: FIXED on branch devin/wave-g/g14-h6-invariants as stroke-heuristic-7 (abstains on the unstable configuration; post-fix 0/594 dangerous flips). RC baseline is v6 — requires merge + parity re-verification of both classifier copies (or of the g26 deduped single copy).
p0.releaseImpact: Measurement-noise-decided confident wrong stroke is exactly the 'confident wrong stroke' P0 class.

p1.title: Capture-envelope overall verdict is non-monotone: strictly worse capture can improve DEGRADED→SUPPORTED
p1.source: g09-f22-surfaces (confirmed violation, 2 counts, pinned); corroborated by g06 (B5/B6 bypasses pass all gates), e15/f18 (thresholds never validated)
p1.status: UNRESOLVED. Root cause is the content-dependent camera_motion frame-diff proxy; fix requires a background-registered motion estimate, not band re-tuning. Also open from g06: brightnessStdLuma computed but never evaluated (B3) and overall verdict equates 'all pass' with 'all measured pass' (B5) — two locally fixable defects.
p1.releaseImpact: Misleading capture verdicts gate what the user trusts; NOT_MEASURED-never-worsens (structural A5) plus pose-gated axes invisible pre-pose compounds it.

p1.title: Noise can manufacture stroke commits from baseline abstentions
p1.status: OPEN (9/594 post-fix perturbed evaluations turn abstention into a committed label, e.g. no_swing_energy_in_window → FOREHAND 0.80 under sigma=0.005 noise). Perturbation-manufactured, not baseline behavior, but shows commitment floors are noise-permeable.
p1.releaseImpact: Bounds confidence in stroke commitment floors under real capture noise.

p1.title: Stroke is the riskiest answering stage and v6 gates are recall-negative on evaluable gold
p1.source: g20-selective-risk (2/5 committed labels wrong, risk 0.4), g15-h6-recall (v6 costs 1 true volley commit, buys 0 silent-wrong reduction on gold), g16 (afn-sasebo-2025-06 now zero-coverage 0/5), g13 (sparse gate net −1 correct on dev; F20-F2 gate inert 0/118), f15 (4 of 9 L1 families at zero gold)
p1.status: UNRESOLVED — label starvation is the binding constraint; 11/29 gold labels unevaluable on Linux (no pose).
p1.releaseImpact: Excess abstention on supported captures + residual wrong commits; acceptable only under the no-claims release posture with canary monitoring.

p1.title: BALL worst slices: fastBlur zero-success and ghost-flight gate rejections
p1.source: g16 (fastBlur 0/6 with 3 wrong-location; 2 e12 abstention violations persist on afn-sasebo-rally2), g17 (19/26 failures are ghost flights rejected by jerky/chronic gates; coupled gate+selection change needed; N too small to tune safely)
p1.status: UNRESOLVED (research direction named; tuning against the locked eval is forbidden).
p1.releaseImpact: Wrong ball locations on fast/blurred captures feed contact errors.

p1.title: CONTACT frontier: wrong markers on volleys and 3/11 estimated wrong
p1.source: g16 (volley family 0/3 acceptable, 2 wrong markers >132ms; dvids-sasebo 1/3), g19 (perfect contact oracle recovers 3/6 failed Results — the largest single-stage recovery), g20 (mid-confidence band 0.55-0.683 dominated: both wrong markers live there)
p1.status: UNRESOLVED at RC. g20's measured selective-risk gates (e.g. ownership margin ≥ 0.575, contact mid-band) are candidate mitigations but small-n (wrong counts 2-4) and session-concentrated — need more sessions before threshold changes.
p1.releaseImpact: Wrong contact markers are user-visible; volley slice worst.

p1.title: Ownership emits no confidence in production; F09 foreign-paddle family only synthetically defended
p1.source: g20 (binary veto; derived margin separates 4/4 wrong picks below 0.717), g01/g02/g05 (F09 fix works on synthetic scenes; real-data wins unmeasurable — labels too sparse, no dense Linux paddle tracks; flags stay OFF), g04 (synchrony route SCIENTIFIC_NEGATIVE)
p1.status: UNRESOLVED / externally gated (dense real paddle tracks = Mac). g16: ownership answers nothing on the clean bucket (0/10) while answering harder ones — evidence gates inverted vs human difficulty.
p1.releaseImpact: All 4 wrong ownership picks concentrated in one session (dvids-944403) — cross-session stability unknown.

p1.title: LiveSummaryScreen does not subscribe to late analysis outcomes
p1.status: OPEN — an already-mounted summary can show stale state until re-render; registry stays consistent.
p1.releaseImpact: Misleading UX (stale READY/PENDING chips) in a core flow; low data risk.

p1.title: Least-privilege DB roles (migration 0018) not in RC; consent enforcement is trigger-only at RC
p1.source: g10-f23-roles / g11-f23-tests (PROVISIONAL_GREEN on their branches: 63/63 destructive attempts denied from real logins; migration chain runs as non-superuser with pgcrypto pre-created)
p1.status: FIXED on branches devin/wave-g/g10-f23-roles + g11-f23-tests; NOT in RC. Trigger-level immutability (0015-0017) IS in RC, so this is defense-in-depth, not a hole.
p1.releaseImpact: Merge before Stage 1; changes deploy prerequisites (admin-created pgcrypto, migration-owner role) — see RELEASE_PLAN_V1 §4.

p1.title: Duplicated stroke classifier copies invite silent drift
p1.source: g25-pr-audit (F1 residual-medium), g26-classifier-dedup (dedup implemented: mobile consumes vision-geometry re-export)
p1.status: FIXED on branch devin/wave-g/g26-classifier-dedup; NOT in RC. g25 also fixed stale header comments and added held-out-consistency pinning test (F2) on its branch.
p1.releaseImpact: Forward-looking maintenance risk; merge order matters vs P0-4 (stroke-heuristic-7 lands cleanest after dedup).

p1.title: Mac-bench harness bit-rot (stages silently dropped; zero-gold crash)
p1.status: FIXED on branch devin/wave-g/g24-mac-harness (poseDerivativesMs/two-pass timings harvested; zero-gold cascade → null with explicit reason). NOT in RC.
p1.releaseImpact: Without it the mandatory Stage-0 Mac re-measure would silently lose evidence — merge before executing the re-measure list.

p1.title: Pose-free OOD gate passes non-play footage (face close-ups, talking heads) with zero reasons
p1.source: g18-fresh-footage (12/12 fresh windows passed incl. >=2 face-only and >=4 non-play; confirms e11's disclosed limitation on genuinely new footage)
p1.status: UNRESOLVED — rejection requires pose-conditioned checks (macOS) or content-level signals that do not exist yet. Also: envelope thresholds classify all 6 fresh clips SUPPORTED, but e15/f18 could not validate the thresholds, so this is classification-only evidence.
p1.releaseImpact: Non-play footage can enter analysis without an OOD rejection on Linux-measurable signals; downstream honest abstention is the only backstop until pose-gated checks run.

p1.title: Abstention reasons are not robust diagnostics under degradation
p1.source: g14 (134/594 post-fix abstentions change reason under noise/dropout/framerate)
p1.status: OPEN — labels stay honest (still abstain); only the reason string is unstable.
p1.releaseImpact: Weakens support/debug value of abstention telemetry; not user-facing.
